note: A review of the spatial structure and temporal behaviour of the Venus ionosphere from Pioneer Venus; abstract only. Consensus holds the book reprint, not the journal DOI you cite. [Kliore and Luhmann 1991](https://consensus.app/papers/details/w:d14e6db7-6775-48cc-a74a-7228b805af35/?utm_source=claude_desktop) does: 200 to 300 km at solar minimum, 200 to over 1000 km at maximum, not 250 to 400 km.
